tagline: The Lotha Naga homeland and the Amur falcon capital
description: Wokha is the district of the Lotha Nagas. The Doyang Reservoir is known worldwide for the millions of Amur falcons that stop here every October on their migration from Siberia to Africa. The district is also the traditional headhunting homeland — now peaceful, with a rich tribal culture.
incitetales_angle: Doyang Reservoir in October: millions of Amur falcons fill the sky at dusk. One of the most extraordinary bird spectacles on Earth.

destinations.name: Wokha
destinations.description: Wokha is a small, pleasant town sitting at the gateway to Doyang Reservoir. It has basic hotels, ATMs, and is the base for visiting the falcon migrations.
what_is_there: Lotha tribal culture — villages around town
local_food: Lotha Naga cuisine — smoked pork, bamboo shoot
local_tips: Stock up fuel and supplies here

destinations.name: Doyang Reservoir
destinations.tagline: Millions of Amur falcons stop here in October — the Falcon capital of the world
destinations.description: Doyang Reservoir is a man-made lake fed by the Doyang River. Every October, millions of Amur falcons descend here for 2–3 weeks on their migration from Siberia to Africa. The birds roost over the water at dusk. The spectacle is extraordinary — the sky turns dark with birds. It is one of the most significant bird migration sites on Earth.
what_is_there: Amur falcon migration — October, millions of birds
Reservoir walk — scenic, birdwatching, morning and dusk
Fishery — traditional fishing methods on the reservoir

stays.name: Forest Rest House at Doyang
stays.notes: Book via Forest Dept. Basic but positioned perfectly for viewing.

local_food: Carry food from Wokha or arrange through Forest Dept
Fresh fish available at the reservoir
local_tips: Amur falcon peak: October 15–25 — arrive a week before for consistent viewing
Dusk viewing: 5:30–6:30pm — birds roost over water, turn sky dark
Bring binoculars and camera with good zoom
November-February: other migratory species still present, good birdwatching
Early morning walks: excellent for other bird species

from_guwahati.notes: Via NH-39 to Dimapur, then mountain road via Merapani route (shorter: 71.7km from Dimapur) or via Kohima route (174km from Dimapur).

from_dimapur.notes: Two routes: via Kohima (174km, longer) or via Merapani (71.7km, shorter, scenic mountain road).

connectivity.mobile: Airtel and BSNL in Wokha town

best_season.notes: October: Amur falcon migration — main reason to visit. Early October: arrival begins. Mid-October: peak numbers. November-February: other migratory species. Clear skies Oct-Nov.
